Office & logistics

Location: {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} — Telehealth available where permitted.

Sessions: 50 or 75 minutes. Sliding scale and short-term focused paths available; full program details on the Investment page.

Contact: {{PHONE}} · {{EMAIL}}

Confidentiality
Your messages and records are kept confidential in accordance with professional standards and local law. Limited exceptions apply (risk of harm, court order, mandated reporting).

Safety & scope

I do not provide crisis services. If you are facing immediate danger or suicidal impulses, call your local emergency number or the nearest crisis line. For U.S. resources, dial or text 988.

I provide outpatient psychotherapy focused on anxiety, trauma-informed care, relationships, and life transitions. Medication management is not offered here; I will coordinate with prescribers when needed.

About this site — quick navigation to core areas

If you'd like to learn more first: the site organizes what others often ask for. These links go to the site areas that explain my practice philosophy and typical outcomes in grounded, evidence-informed language.

"} {"path":"README.md","content":"# {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — Contact page & project notes\n\nThis chunk includes the contact page and a short README for the private practice therapist site. The design family is "earthy_warm" with a calm, organic visual language and a scientist_guide voice: clinical, clear, and guiding.\n\nFiles included:\n- contact.html — full contact / intake page template.\n\nPlaceholders used (please replace before publishing):\n- {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — practice or business name\n- {{TAGLINE}} — short tagline under brand\n- {{PHONE}} — main contact phone number\n- {{EMAIL}} — primary contact email\n- {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} — main CTA label (e.g., "Request an intake")\n- {{PRIMARY_CTA_URL}} — target URL for main CTA (e.g., booking link)\n- {{THERAPIST_NAME}} — clinician name used on logo/brand area\n- {{LICENSE}} — clinician license and credential string (e.g., "LCSW #12345")\n- {{MODALITIES}} — therapy modalities offered (e.g., "CBT, EMDR, ACT")\n- {{CITY}} — city where practice is based\n- {{STATE}} — state abbreviation or full state name\n\nDesign notes: \n- Layout: responsive two-column hero with a warm card sidebar. The contact form is intentionally simple and non-clinical while including essential fields used for triage and scheduling.\n- Colors: warm palette (earth tones) appropriate for "earthy_warm" family. All styles are inlined for portability — no external fonts or CDNs.\n- Accessibility: clear labels, logical heading order, button contrast, and responsive breakpoints.\n- Assets: this file references local assets (assets/img/pattern.svg) for subtle patterning. Ensure the associated SVG files are present in the assets/img folder in other project chunks.\n\nClinical & legal notes (must be preserved):\n- Confidentiality statement, scope of practice, and crisis disclaimer are included on the page.\n- Do not present the therapist as providing guaranteed outcomes or medical treatments. Avoid diagnostic or treatment promises.\n- Replace the crisis instruction (e.g., 988) with relevant local emergency guidance if outside the U.S.\n\nForm behavior:\n- The form uses a mailto fallback for demonstration. In production, wire the form to a secure server or HIPAA-compliant intake tool.\n- Update the form action or implement server-side handling to record inquiries and schedule follow-ups.\n\nNavigation & content linking: \n- The contact page includes contextual quick links to site sections (Debunking, Core principles, Client stories, FAQ, Next steps). These are designed to "ripple" the required site sections (hero, myth_vs_truth, pillars, case_studies, faq, cta) across pages.\n- Nav labels intentionally vary across pages (see other templates in the project) to meet the uniqueness requirement — e.g., "Work With Me" used on the booking link.\n\nCustomization tips: \n- Change the logo area in the header to a real SVG or image and remove the simple text-based mark.\n- Localize the emergency guidance for your jurisdiction.\n- If you offer a membership program, describe it on the index and fees pages. Use distinct program names and pricing presentation across templates (this contact page mentions "membership" only in passing as "Next steps & membership" to preserve uniqueness).\n\nDeveloper notes: \n- No external JavaScript libraries or analytics are included. Any client-side form enhancements should be progressive and preserve the accessibility of the base form.\n- Ensure server endpoints that accept form content use TLS and follow privacy standards for storing PHI.\n\nIf you need additional page variants (e.g., a minimal contact modal, multi-step intake, or HIPAA-ready form integration), I can provide examples and implementation details for your preferred backend or form provider."} BUNDLE_END
